title: Frappe desk mock spec, version 1
description: One page of a static Frappe v16 desk mockup: { page, ctx, meta, data, overlays, view }. Reference: docs/SPEC.md. Validated by `node bin/mock.mjs validate`, which implements the JSON Schema subset used here (type, enum, const, required, properties, patternProperties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, minLength, pattern, oneOf, anyOf, $ref to #/$defs).

$schema.description: Spec format id. Use "mock-spec/1"; a relative path ending in mock-spec.schema.json is also accepted for editor support.

extends.description: Path (relative to this spec file) of a base spec. Objects merge deeply, arrays and scalars replace, null removes a key.

title.description: Document <title> of the rendered page. Optional; renderers may supply one.

^(x-|_).description: Free-form notes and extensions; ignored by the engine.

page.description: Page type. Dispatches to renderers/<page>/index.mjs. `blank` is the shell with an empty main slot.

ref.description: Metadata reference: a path to a JSON file (contains '/' or ends in .json; relative to the spec file, then the kit root), a Frappe name looked up in the kind's search dirs, or the inline Frappe JSON object itself.

ctx.description: Rendering context. Everything environment-like is data here; the engine reads no clock, locale or env.

viewport.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT or a preset (desktop = 1440x900, tablet = 768x1024, mobile = 375x812).

today.description: The date the mock pretends it is (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for relative dates, overdue colours, calendar focus, gantt today marker.

now.description: Time of day for 'x minutes ago' (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss). Defaults to `${today} 12:00:00`.

workspace.description: Selected workspace sidebar (name of a Workspace Sidebar).

breadcrumbs.description: Navbar breadcrumbs, left to right. Omit to let the renderer derive them.

shell.description: false renders the page body without any desk chrome.

mobile_sidebar.description: Mobile (<768px) only: off-canvas sidebar drawer state.

navbar.description: Navbar content when chrome.navbar is true.

desk_settings.description: User desk settings (User doctype checkboxes). All default true.

perms.description: Optional permission overrides per doctype: { "<DocType>": { "create": false, "delete": false, ... } }. Absent means all allowed.

system.description: System Settings values that change how numbers, dates and money look.

currency_precision.description: Decimals for Currency fields. null means: take it from number_format.

currency.description: Default currency code when a doc has none.

time_zone.description: Display only; never used to compute anything.

meta.description: Frappe-native metadata, each value a ref. Known keys are listed; page renderers may read others (additional keys must still be refs).

doctype.description: DocType JSON (name looked up in doctype/fixtures/*/<snake>.json).

children.description: Extra child or linked DocTypes not found by name: { "<DocType>": ref }.

custom.description: Custom fields / property setters, applied by doctype/lib/customize.mjs. One ref or a list.

workspace.description: Workspace JSON (content blocks, shortcuts, links, charts, number_cards, quick_lists, custom_blocks).

sidebar.description: Workspace Sidebar JSON (name looked up in doctype/workspaces/<snake>.json).

gen.description: Ask the sample-data generator (data/gen.mjs) to fill this slot deterministically.

data.description: Sample data. Page renderers may read further keys (events, chart data, columns, ...).

doc.description: The document shown by a form (null = new unsaved form), as an object, a path to a .doc.json, or $gen.

rows.description: Rows for list, report and other collection views.

total.description: Total count shown in paging ('20 of 1,234'). Defaults to rows.length.

linkPools.description: { "<Link target DocType>": [names...] } used by the generator for Link values.

view.description: Which part of the page is showing. Page renderers may read further keys.

tab.description: Form tab, by label or 0-based index.

collapsed.description: Collapsible section labels shown collapsed (or expanded when collapsible by default).

ov_button.description: A button the app adds at runtime (frm.add_custom_button, page.add_inner_button, page.set_primary_action). Buttons with the same `group` collapse into one dropdown.

primary_action.description: true replaces the page's primary action (Save/Submit) with this button.

target.description: Where it goes. Default `page.actions` (page head). Also `row_actions:<n>`, `field:<fieldname>` (grid/field buttons).

ov_menu_open.description: Render one dropdown/popover in its open state. `target` comes from the menu target registry (docs/SPEC.md).

query.description: Typed text, for search-like targets (navbar.search, field:<name>).

current.description: page.views: label of the active saved view (shown checked).

ov_dialog.description: A modal (frappe.ui.Dialog, frappe.confirm, frappe.msgprint, Quick Entry). Several dialogs stack in array order; the last is on top.

kind.description: Generic kinds (dialog, confirm, msgprint, quick_entry) or a named dialog id. Named dialogs read their own keys (see docs/SLICE3.md): assign_to {assign_to, myself, description, date, priority}, share {users, everyone}, attach {tab: device|link|camera, files, private, url}, add_tag {tag, tags}, rename {name, new_name, merge}, email {to, cc, subject, message, attachments, template}, msgprint_list {messages, intro}, missing_mandatory {doctype, fields}, modified_conflict {message, modified}, server_error {message, traceback}; list_settings, quick_filters, save_view {fields, values}; report dialogs pick_columns, add_column, report_export (export), report_save_as (save_as), report_create_chart (create_chart) read available/selected/doctypes/formats/chart_types/values (see docs/SLICE4.md).

message.description: HTML-free text for confirm/msgprint. Lines split on \n.

doctype.description: quick_entry: the DocType whose mandatory fields are shown (a ref resolved like meta.doctype).

fields.description: DocField-shaped objects (fieldname, fieldtype, label, options, reqd, default, description, ...), rendered with doctype/fields/*.mjs. Section Break / Column Break allowed.

anyOf.description: A field label or fieldname (named dialogs such as list_settings and missing_mandatory).

values.description: { fieldname: value } shown in the fields.

ov_list_select.description: Checked rows in a list/report and the bulk-action bar. `rows` are 0-based indexes or "all".

bulk.description: Actions menu items; omit for the generated set.

filter.description: Frappe filter tuple: [fieldname, operator, value] or [doctype, fieldname, operator, value].

ov_filter_chips.description: Applied filters shown as chips in the filter bar (and as the filter count).

open.description: Show the filter popover open with these rows.

ov_state.description: Pin one element in an interaction state. Target syntax is in docs/SPEC.md (row:N, cell:N:field, field:name, button:label, tab:label, link:label, card:label, ui:<data-ui id>).

ov_row_open.description: Open a child-table row in its row form (Frappe grid-row-open): heading with Insert Above/Below, Duplicate, Move, Delete, the child DocType's fields, and "Edit in full page". `child` nests to open a grandchild row inside the expanded form.

field.description: Fieldname of the Table field on the form.

child.description: A row of a Table field inside the expanded row form, same shape (nests).

ov_field_open.description: Show one form field open or in a special state. state `open` (default): Link/Dynamic Link/Autocomplete results dropdown (query, results, create, advanced), Date/Datetime/Time picker (value), Color picker (value), Table MultiSelect (chips, results). state `error`: mandatory highlight. state `readonly`: permlevel read-only.

create.description: true, or the label of the create row.

ov_toast.description: frappe.show_alert toast. Several stack bottom-up in array order.
